data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled, but leaves8 fewer tons and16 fewer next month in the doubling outcome. This need not maximize long-run income; intentions aren't enforceable, and other catches require recalculation. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
